full_judgment: 15. We have perused the record as placed. The suit is for a decree of several declarations including one that the plaintiffs are still sole distributor of Birla Brand Tyres for whole of Bangladesh. The agency of the plaintiffs was already terminated on 29-1-03. The plaintiffs however do not want to accept that their agency and/or distributorship was validly terminated. They relied upon section 202 of the Contract Act. But it is a fact as appears from the plaint that the defendants totally stopped issuing any proforma invoices and asked the plaintiffs not to open any further letter of credit since January, 2003 and the business of the agency was stopped since then. Then, on 9-8-2003, that is after more than seven months, the suit was instituted.
